verdict.rationale: LegalZoom says it completes all the paperwork to switch registered agents and updates the agent information with the Secretary of State. That answers "who files it", but only generically, not on a per-state basis. It also says its address replaces yours on public records, but it publishes no state-by-state agent addresses and does not name the designation forms. Missing for 10: per-state registered agent addresses, the form that designates the agent in each state, and a published per-state appointment reference.
